text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean absolute error of an XGBoost model given the ensemble mean upsampled one way, minus the same model given it upsampled another way, on the same generator-hours. Days 0 to 5 sit on ENS's 3-hour steps, days 7 to 14 on its 6-hour steps. All marks are exploratory. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, every hour, August 2024 to September 2026.'
